name: Kiss

whyMatters.en: New York makeup hard rock/metal. Rock and Roll All Nite (1975) as chant anthem; Alive! as a live-album sales peak; I Was Made for Lovin' You (1979) adds disco-tempo crossover while keeping the stage look.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约化妆 hard rock/metal。《Rock and Roll All Nite》（1975）作口号颂歌；《Alive!》作现场专辑销量高峰；《I Was Made for Lovin' You》（1979）加入 disco 速度跨界，同时保留舞台形象。

essentialTracks.title: I Was Made for Lovin' You

lyricQuotes: I wanna rock and roll all night / And party every day
I was made for lovin' you baby / You were made for lovin' me

shortBio.en: NY makeup hard rock/metal; Rock and Roll All Nite chant, Alive! live peak, Lovin' You disco-tempo hit.
shortBio.zh: 纽约化妆 hard rock/metal；《Rock and Roll All Nite》口号、《Alive!》现场高峰、《Lovin' You》disco 速度热单。

body.en:
Kiss formed in 1973 from Wicked Lester remnants (Stanley/Simmons) with Frehley and Criss. Dressed To Kill and Alive! (1975) sell three-chord hard rock plus pyrotechnic stage craft—Rock and Roll All Nite is the chant chorus. Destroyer (1976, Bob Ezrin) adds Detroit Rock City and the ballad Beth.

Dynasty (1979) pushes I Was Made for Lovin' You: four-on-the-floor tempo. Later lineup changes aside, the classic four faces remain the public image. The makeup-off 1980s Lick It Up era still uses similar riff and chant writing.
body.zh:
Kiss 于 1973 年由 Wicked Lester 残余（Stanley/Simmons）加 Frehley、Criss 组建。《Dressed To Kill》与《Alive!》（1975）卖三和弦 hard rock 加烟火舞台——《Rock and Roll All Nite》是口号副歌。《Destroyer》（1976，Bob Ezrin）加入《Detroit Rock City》与谣曲《Beth》。

《Dynasty》（1979）推出《I Was Made for Lovin' You》：四拍底鼓速度。后期阵容变化另论，经典四张脸仍是公众形象。80 年代卸妆《Lick It Up》期仍使用相近的 riff 与口号写法。

note.en: Chant-chorus hard-rock anthem; peak live document on Alive!.
note.zh: 口号副歌 hard-rock 颂歌；《Alive!》现场文献高峰。

scenes.track: I Was Made for Lovin' You

note.en: Disco four-on-the-floor tempo on Dynasty; Stanley lead vocal.
note.zh: 《Dynasty》上的 disco 四拍底鼓速度；Stanley 主唱。

title.zh: 舞台形象与三和弦歌曲

body.en:
Kiss treat makeup, boots, and pyro as equal parts of the show. Songwriting stays three-chord hard rock/early metal with Stanley/Simmons hooks.

Alive! (1975) outsold several studio albums for this band.

I Was Made for Lovin' You shows chart-tempo flexibility without dropping the faces.
body.zh:
Kiss 把化妆、厚底靴与烟火当作演出的同等部分。写作保持三和弦 hard rock/早期金属 + Stanley/Simmons 钩子。

《Alive!》（1975）对这支乐队而言销量超过多张录音室专辑。

《I Was Made for Lovin' You》显示榜单速度弹性，同时保留脸谱。

body.en:
Stanley, Simmons, Frehley, and Criss define 1973–1980 peak. Criss exits; Frehley exits in the early 80s; Vinnie Vincent and others rotate.

1996 reunion restores the classic makeup four for tours.

Public recognition of the four faces often outranks any single guitarist era.
body.zh:
Stanley、Simmons、Frehley、Criss 定义 1973–1980 巅峰。Criss 离队；Frehley 80 年代初离队；Vinnie Vincent 等轮换。

1996 重聚恢复经典化妆四人巡演。

四张脸的公众辨识度常强过任何单一吉他手时期。

title.en: Arena chant and glam hard rock
title.zh: 体育场口号与 glam hard rock

body.en:
1980s glam/hard-rock acts copy the merch-plus-riff approach. Metallica and others cite early Kiss as entry hard rock/metal.

Rock and Roll All Nite remains a clear chant-structure reference.

Influence is showcraft and simplicity, not progressive technique.
body.zh:
80 年代 glam/hard-rock 乐队复制周边加 riff 的做法。Metallica 等引早期 Kiss 作入门 hard rock/metal。

《Rock and Roll All Nite》仍是清楚的口号结构参照。

影响在秀与简洁，而非 progressive 技术。

body.en:
Chant-chorus hard-rock anthem from Dressed To Kill / Alive!.

The live version on Alive! is the best-known document of the song.
body.zh:
出自《Dressed To Kill》/《Alive!》的口号副歌 hard-rock 颂歌。

《Alive!》现场版是这首歌最知名的文献。

body.en: Opener on Destroyer (1976). Bob Ezrin production; narrative lyric about a drive to a show.
body.zh: 《Destroyer》（1976）开场曲。Bob Ezrin 制作；歌词写驾车赶场。

title.en: I Was Made for Lovin' You

body.en: Dynasty (1979) crossover single: disco four-on-the-floor tempo with Kiss lead vocal and stage look intact.
body.zh: 《Dynasty》（1979）跨界单曲：disco 四拍底鼓速度，Kiss 主唱与舞台形象仍在。

interviewQuotes.text: We are a hard rock band. The makeup is the package—the songs still have to rock.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Paul Stanley

interviewQuotes.text: Alive! is when people understood Kiss. The studio records were the blueprint; the stage was the product.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Gene Simmons

label.en: Original four: Stanley / Simmons / Frehley / Criss
label.zh: 原班四人：Stanley / Simmons / Frehley / Criss

note.en: Alive! / Destroyer / Dynasty; makeup hard-rock/metal peak.

note.zh: 口号副歌；70 年代 hard-rock 体育场参照曲。

note.en: Stage spectacle plus three-chord riffs; Alive! as live-sales peak.
note.zh: 舞台视觉秀加三和弦 riff；《Alive!》作现场销量高峰。
